title: Whale holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='82' cy='44' r='2' fill='#7AC0F0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='36' r='1.5' fill='#7AC0F0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#7AC0F0' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
